description:
Scholarship Overview

The Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) Scholarship 2027 is a fully-funded opportunity offered to international and Qatari students pursuing Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degrees at HBKU in Qatar. The scholarship is designed to attract talented students worldwide and support their academic and research growth in a environment.

Scholarship Benefits

  • Full tuition fee coverage.
  • Monthly stipend for living expenses.
  • Free on-campus housing.
  • Health insurance coverage.
  • Annual round-trip flights to home country.
  • Full access to research labs and libraries.
  • No application fee.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Academic Excellence: Strong academic record (typically 85% or above in previous qualifications).
  • Program-specific requirements: Bachelor's degree for Master's programs; Master's degree and strong research proposal for PhD programs.
  • English Language Proficiency: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 79+ (for English-taught programs).
  • Open to all nationalities. International students deadline: 1 February 2027. Qatari students deadline: 15 March 2027.

Available Colleges

  • Islamic Studies
  • Science & Engineering
  • Law
  • Health & Life Sciences
  • Public Policy
  • Humanities & Social Sciences
  • Economics & Management

Research Institutes

  • Qatar Environment and Energy Research Institute (QEERI)
  • Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI)
  • Qatar Biomedical Research Institute (QBRI)

Application Process

  1. Choose your program on the HBKU admissions portal.
  2. Check eligibility and specific requirements for your program.
  3. Prepare required documents: passport copy, educational certificates and transcripts, CV/Resume, Statement of Purpose, two recommendation letters, proof of English proficiency, research proposal (for PhD).
  4. Submit the online application by 1 February 2027 (international students) or 15 March 2027 (Qatari students).
  5. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview.
  6. Final decisions announced in April-May 2027.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application Deadline (International)1 February 2027
Application Deadline (Qatari)15 March 2027
InterviewsFebruary-March 2027
Final DecisionApril-May 2027
Program StartSeptember 2027

Official Links

  • Scholarship Portal: https://www.hbku.edu.qa/en/admissions/financial-aid/scholarships
  • Admissions Page: https://www.hbku.edu.qa/en/admissions
  • Colleges Page: https://www.hbku.edu.qa/en/academics/colleges
  • Application Portal: https://apply.hbku.edu.qa/

Important Notes

  • No application fee. Beware of scams.
  • Most programs are taught in English. Arabic not required for English-taught programs.
  • HBKU is located in Education City, alongside other top universities.
  • Contact HBKU admissions office for official guidance.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 February 2027 (International Students). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
